paper_title: Metapath Context Convolution-based Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network (MECCH)
core_problem: Existing metapath-based models in HGNNs suffer from either information loss or high computation costs, and existing HGNNs degrade in performance when deep.
methodology_summary: MECCH is a novel Metapath Context Convolution-based HGNN that leverages metapath contexts (a new graph structure) to facilitate lossless node information aggregation without redundancy. It uses three novel components: metapath context construction, metapath context encoder, and convolutional metapath fusion.
empirical_results: MECCH achieves superior prediction accuracy compared with state-of-the-art baselines with improved computational efficiency on node classification and link prediction tasks.
explicit_limitations: Existing metapath-based HGNNs struggle to balance model performance and computational efficiency; HAN (Wang et al., 2019a) causes information loss by discarding intermediate nodes along metapaths.
pipeline_steps: However, existing metapath-based models suffer from either information loss or high computation costs.
